scenario.name: r-cd-2-silent-wake
scenario.description: continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake') full path. Fires a delegate that returns silently and triggers a fresh parent turn without channel output.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply with DONE and the nonce only. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continuation row. Fail closed when token/session env is missing, serialize per target session, and treat generated output as a PASS-candidate until required receipts are reviewed.

expectedReceipts.name: unbound-disposable-session
expectedReceipts.description: Fresh disposable session created and confirmed through sessions.list with no channel delivery binding

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the dispatching sessions.send request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate(mode=silent-wake)

expectedReceipts.name: task-ledger-entry
expectedReceipts.description: Optional extra context from the generic TaskFlow task ledger; continue_delegate does not reliably write here

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-scheduled-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: Nonce-correlated parent receipt emitted only after the continue_delegate tool result reports scheduled

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-failure-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: Redacted fail-closed classification when the provider/agent turn fails or queued continue_delegate is incomplete/replay-unsafe

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-turn-completed
expectedReceipts.description: Run-ID-correlated terminal lifecycle success for the dispatching parent turn

expectedReceipts.name: post-wake-no-delivery-window
expectedReceipts.description: Bounded observation window after the correlated parent wake with no outbound channel-delivery event

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-key
expectedReceipts.description: Child session key from task metadata

expectedReceipts.name: parent-wake-event
expectedReceipts.description: Parent session wakes after silent return (session.message or run event with no channel delivery)

expectedReceipts.name: no-channel-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return does NOT produce a channel message (silent mode verified)

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-lifecycle-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: Row-scoped public-safe verdict from the strict typed-tool/dispatch/fire same-trace, same-chain silent-wake correlation

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from dispatch response or optional task metadata; Tempo trace JSON must be fetched before folding a PASS.

review.notes: Silent-wake path. PASS-candidate requires: (1) a fresh disposable session confirmed to have no channel binding, (2) dispatching agent turn accepted, (3) nonce-correlated delegate-scheduled receipt, (4) run-ID-correlated terminal success for the dispatching turn, (5) nonce-correlated delayed parent wake after scheduling, (6) a bounded post-wake window with no explicit message-tool delivery receipt, and (7) trace/receipt artifacts fetched for review. Provider/turn failure or incomplete/replay-unsafe delegate rejection is fail-closed PARTIAL-candidate. Bound live sessions are intentionally unsupported because the subscribed Gateway stream does not expose a reliable normal channel-delivery receipt.
